title: Tamarin theories and results for: Bottom-Up Formal Verification Of Temporal Constraints In Self-Orchestrated Business Processes
description: Tamarin theories, the script that runs them and the summaries of every run for the TDK 2026 paper "Bottom-Up Formal Verification Of Temporal Constraints In Self-Orchestrated Business Processes". One theory per layer of the system model (layers 1-3, 4, 5, 6 and 7), plus four negative controls. Run with Tamarin 1.12.0 and Maude 3.5.1. The full proof files are not included; run_all.sh regenerates them.
